title: Your invitation to a shared universe
summary: Join a private experimental server from Home.

changes.text: Paste your host’s private invitation on Home to check the server and join its shared scene.
Rejoin with the same invitation to return as the same player. Invitations stay private and are remembered only while the launcher is open.
See when the shared scene is connected or the connection is lost. Connection details are available in Settings.
This is the first experimental shared-scene connection. Full campaign multiplayer and Internet hosting setup are still in development.

title: Steadier worker sessions
summary: Choose workers and close the launcher with confidence.

changes.text: Live status updates keep the worker list open and preserve your selection.
Closing the launcher during a worker start or stop lets that request finish safely.
The diagnostic log created by normal Play no longer prevents a later worker or game launch.

title: Worker startup stays responsive
summary: Keep using the launcher after starting a worker.

changes.text: Starting a worker now releases the busy state so its status and Stop control become available while SPORE continues running.

title: More reliable worker controls
summary: Keep control of the worker you selected.

changes.text: Stop stays attached to the selected worker session if that worker restarts while the request is being sent.
A worker with unreadable settings no longer hides the status or controls of another healthy worker.
A worker that fails to answer a shutdown request is stopped after the timeout, and the forced stop is recorded.

title: Worker window guidance
summary: Know how to keep experimental workers advancing.

changes.text: Worker Settings now explains that minimizing a worker pauses its simulation and can cause it to time out. Keep worker windows open and unminimized.

title: Local worker controls
summary: Manage prepared experimental workers from Settings.

changes.text: Select, start and stop a prepared isolated worker in Settings. Worker startup opens a separate SPORE window.
See live worker status, including startup, scene readiness, pauses and crashes. Status refreshes while Settings is open.
Play stays available when the only running SPORE processes belong to recognized isolated workers.
A worker that gets stuck during startup is stopped and its diagnostic logs are preserved. Full multiplayer gameplay and checkpoint recovery remain in development.

title: Your screen, your settings
summary: Choose your resolution and display mode before starting SPORE.

changes.text: Choose Fullscreen or Windowed and a resolution directly in Settings > Display.
Use Desktop resolution to match your primary display automatically at each launch.
Saved display choices are applied every time you launch SPORE. You can also switch back to the game's own settings.
A display shortcut on Home shows your saved choice. Changes made while playing take effect on your next launch.

title: A new home for your universe
summary: A clearer Play screen. More room for every update.

changes.text: A new home screen with a spacious illustration, a prominent Play button and game readiness at a glance.
Permanent Home, What's new and Settings navigation keeps everything within easy reach.
Search release notes by version, date or words from any change. Pick a release to read its full details.
Cleaner Settings for your game folder and installation choice, with troubleshooting tucked away until you need it.
More readable text, clearer selected and keyboard focus states, and layouts that scroll on smaller displays.
Use Ctrl+1 for Home, Ctrl+2 for What's new, Ctrl+comma for Settings, and Ctrl+F to search updates.

title: Your updates, in one place
summary: See what changed before you jump back into SPORE.

changes.text: Latest update highlights on the launcher's home screen.
A full release history with version numbers, dates and readable change lists.
Release notes are included with the launcher and stay available offline.

title: A simpler way to launch SPORE
summary: Open the launcher, press Play SPORE, and use your existing game and saves.

changes.text: Automatic detection of supported SPORE installations.
Play with your normal Windows account and existing saves. No separate profile or backup setup required.
Automatic compatibility checks before starting the game.
A redesigned home screen, with installation options and local support reports in Settings.
